segments: Optional LIST of IFCLINEINDEX (2+) or IFCARCINDEX (3) typed aggregate. Explicit connectivity and closure use shared sourceindex identity. Omitted segments connect listed points and close by pointcoordinate equality.
arc: Start,onarc,end; orientation and major/minor span through middle; exact collinearity is polyline. Bounded chord sampling with maximumangularstep2pi/72; retain original middle and endpoints.
control: Work tick for each sourceindex, point and arc sample; existing limits/cancellation unchanged.
